verses.text: I will give thanks unto Jehovah with my whole heart; I will show forth all thy marvellous works.

segments.text: I will give thanks unto Jehovah with my whole heart;
I will show forth all thy marvellous works.

verses.text: I will be glad and exult in thee; I will sing praise to thy name, O thou Most High.

segments.text: I will be glad and exult in thee;
I will sing praise to thy name, O thou Most High.

verses.text: When mine enemies turn back, They stumble and perish at thy presence.

segments.text: When mine enemies turn back,
They stumble and perish at thy presence.

verses.text: For thou hast maintained my right and my cause; Thou sittest in the throne judging righteously.

segments.text: For thou hast maintained my right and my cause;
Thou sittest in the throne judging righteously.

verses.text: Thou hast rebuked the nations, thou hast destroyed the wicked; Thou hast blotted out their name for ever and ever.

segments.text: Thou hast rebuked the nations, thou hast destroyed the wicked;
Thou hast blotted out their name for ever and ever.

verses.text: The enemy are come to an end, they are desolate for ever; And the cities which thou hast overthrown, The very remembrance of them is perished.

segments.text: The enemy are come to an end, they are desolate for ever;
And the cities which thou hast overthrown,
The very remembrance of them is perished.

verses.text: But Jehovah sitteth as king for ever: He hath prepared his throne for judgment;

segments.text: But Jehovah sitteth
as king
for ever:
He hath prepared his throne for judgment;

verses.text: And he will judge the world in righteousness, He will minister judgment to the peoples in uprightness.

segments.text: And he will judge the world in righteousness,
He will minister judgment to the peoples in uprightness.

verses.text: Jehovah also will be a high tower for the oppressed, A high tower in times of trouble;

segments.text: Jehovah also will be a high tower for the oppressed,
A high tower in times of trouble;

verses.text: And they that know thy name will put their trust in thee; For thou, Jehovah, hast not forsaken them that seek thee.

segments.text: And they that know thy name will put their trust in thee;
For thou, Jehovah, hast not forsaken them that seek thee.

verses.text: Sing praises to Jehovah, who dwelleth in Zion: Declare among the people his doings.

segments.text: Sing praises to Jehovah, who dwelleth in Zion:
Declare among the people his doings.

verses.text: For he that maketh inquisition for blood remembereth them; He forgetteth not the cry of the poor.

segments.text: For he that maketh inquisition for blood remembereth them;
He forgetteth not the cry of the poor.

verses.text: Have mercy upon me, O Jehovah; Behold my affliction which I suffer of them that hate me, Thou that liftest me up from the gates of death;

segments.text: Have mercy upon me, O Jehovah;
Behold my affliction
which I suffer
of them that hate me,
Thou that liftest me up from the gates of death;

verses.text: That I may show forth all thy praise. In the gates of the daughter of Zion I will rejoice in thy salvation.

segments.text: That I may show forth all thy praise.
In the gates of the daughter of Zion
I will rejoice in thy salvation.

verses.text: The nations are sunk down in the pit that they made: In the net which they hid is their own foot taken.

segments.text: The nations are sunk down in the pit that they made:
In the net which they hid is their own foot taken.

verses.text: Jehovah hath made himself known, he hath executed judgment: The wicked is snared in the work of his own hands. [Higgaion. Selah

segments.text: Jehovah hath made himself known, he hath executed judgment:
The wicked is snared in the work of his own hands. [Higgaion. Selah

verses.text: The wicked shall be turned back unto Sheol, Even all the nations that forget God.

segments.text: The wicked shall be turned back unto Sheol,
Even all the nations that forget God.

verses.text: For the needy shall not alway be forgotten, Nor the expectation of the poor perish for ever.

segments.text: For the needy shall not alway be forgotten,
Nor the expectation of the poor perish for ever.

verses.text: Arise, O Jehovah; let not man prevail: Let the nations be judged in thy sight.

segments.text: Arise, O Jehovah; let not man prevail:
Let the nations be judged in thy sight.

verses.text: Put them in fear, O Jehovah: Let the nations know themselves to be but men. [Selah

segments.text: Put them in fear, O Jehovah:
Let the nations know themselves to be but men. [Selah

headings.text: For the Chief Musician; set to Muth-labben. A Psalm of David.
